      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(\"cedint_f1_hourly_clean.csv.gz\")\n",
        "df.head()\n",
        "df.columns\n",
        "df[\"timestamp_local\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"timestamp_local\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"hour\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.hour\n",
        "df[\"weekday\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.day_name()\n",
        "df[\"month\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.month\n",
        "df[\"year\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.year\n",
        "df[\"is_weekend\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.dayofweek >= 5\n",
        "df[[\"timestamp_local\", \"hour\", \"weekday\", \"month\", \"year\", \"is_weekend\"]].head()\n",
        "nw_hvac = df[\n",
        "    (df[\"zone\"] == \"NW\") &\n",
        "    (df[\"load_type\"] == \"HVAC\") &\n",
        "    (df[\"usable_for_model\"] == 1)\n",
        "].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "nw_hvac.shape\n",
        "hourly_profile = nw_hvac.groupby(\"hour\")[\"energy_wh_model\"].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "hourly_profile\n",
        "hourly_profile.plot()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Hour of day\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"NW HVAC - Average energy by hour\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "workweek_profile = nw_hvac.groupby([\"hour\", \"is_weekend\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"].mean().unstack()\n",
        "\n",
        "workweek_profile.plot()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Hour of day\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"NW HVAC - Working days vs weekends\")\n",
        "plt.legend([\"Working days\", \"Weekend\"])\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "year_profile = nw_hvac.groupby(\"year\")[\"energy_wh_model\"].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "year_profile.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Year\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"NW HVAC - Average energy by year\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "nw_hvac[\"period_group\"] = nw_hvac[\"year\"].apply(\n",
        "    lambda x: \"2020-2023\" if x <= 2023 else \"2025\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "period_profile = nw_hvac.groupby(\"period_group\")[\"energy_wh_model\"].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "period_profile.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Period\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"NW HVAC - 2020-2023 vs 2025\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "nw_hvac[\"is_august\"] = nw_hvac[\"month\"] == 8\n",
        "\n",
        "august_profile = nw_hvac.groupby(\"is_august\")[\"energy_wh_model\"].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "august_profile.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xticks([0, 1], [\"Other months\", \"August\"], rotation=0)\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"NW HVAC - August vs other months\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "monthly_profile = nw_hvac.groupby(\"month\")[\"energy_wh_model\"].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "monthly_profile.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Month\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"NW HVAC - Average energy by month\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "weekday_order = [\n",
        "    \"Monday\", \"Tuesday\", \"Wednesday\",\n",
        "    \"Thursday\", \"Friday\", \"Saturday\", \"Sunday\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "weekday_profile = (\n",
        "    nw_hvac.groupby(\"weekday\")[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .reindex(weekday_order)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "weekday_profile.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Weekday\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"NW HVAC - Average energy by weekday\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "nw_lighting = df[\n",
        "    (df[\"zone\"] == \"NW\") &\n",
        "    (df[\"load_type\"] == \"Lighting\") &\n",
        "    (df[\"usable_for_model\"] == 1)\n",
        "].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_hourly = nw_lighting.groupby(\"hour\")[\"energy_wh_model\"].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_hourly.plot()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Hour of day\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"NW Lighting - Average energy by hour\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "lighting = df[\n",
        "    (df[\"load_type\"] == \"Lighting\") &\n",
        "    (df[\"usable_for_model\"] == 1)\n",
        "].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_by_zone = (\n",
        "    lighting.groupby([\"hour\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_by_zone.plot()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Hour of day\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Lighting - Average energy by hour and zone\")\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "hvac = df[\n",
        "    (df[\"load_type\"] == \"HVAC\") &\n",
        "    (df[\"usable_for_model\"] == 1)\n",
        "].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_by_zone = (\n",
        "    hvac.groupby([\"hour\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_by_zone.plot()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Hour of day\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"HVAC - Average energy by hour and zone\")\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plugs = df[\n",
        "    (df[\"load_type\"] == \"Plugs & Sockets\") &\n",
        "    (df[\"usable_for_model\"] == 1)\n",
        "].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "plugs_by_zone = (\n",
        "    plugs.groupby([\"hour\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plugs_by_zone.plot()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Hour of day\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Plugs & Sockets - Average energy by hour and zone\")\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "weekday_order = [\n",
        "    \"Monday\", \"Tuesday\", \"Wednesday\",\n",
        "    \"Thursday\", \"Friday\", \"Saturday\", \"Sunday\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_weekday = (\n",
        "    hvac.groupby([\"weekday\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        "    .reindex(weekday_order)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_weekday.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Weekday\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"HVAC - Average energy by weekday and zone\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_weekday = (\n",
        "    lighting.groupby([\"weekday\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        "    .reindex(weekday_order)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_weekday.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Weekday\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Lighting - Average energy by weekday and zone\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "plugs_weekday = (\n",
        "    plugs.groupby([\"weekday\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        "    .reindex(weekday_order)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plugs_weekday.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Weekday\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Plugs & Sockets - Average energy by weekday and zone\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "hvac_monthly = (\n",
        "    hvac.groupby([\"month\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .sum()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_monthly.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Month\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Total energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"HVAC - Monthly total energy by zone\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=0)\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_monthly = (\n",
        "    lighting.groupby([\"month\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .sum()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_monthly.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Month\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Total energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Lighting - Monthly total energy by zone\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=0)\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plugs_monthly = (\n",
        "    plugs.groupby([\"month\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",

        "plt.xlabel(\"Month\")\n",

        "plt.xticks(rotation=0)\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_workweek = (\n",
        "    hvac.groupby([\"is_weekend\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .unstack()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_workweek.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Day type\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"HVAC - Working days vs weekends by zone\")\n",
        "plt.xticks([0, 1], [\"Working days\", \"Weekend\"], rotation=0)\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "lighting_workweek = (\n",
        "    lighting.groupby([\"is_weekend\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",

        ")\n",

        "\n",

        "plt.xticks([0, 1], [\"Other months\", \"August\"], rotation=0)\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_compare = hvac[hvac[\"month\"].isin([8, 9, 10])].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "hvac_compare[\"period\"] = hvac_compare[\"year\"].apply(\n",

        "hvac_covid = hvac[hvac[\"month\"].isin([8, 9, 10])].copy()\n",

        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# P7 - EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS: PAST ENERGY CONSUMPTION\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 1. LOAD DATA\n",
        "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(\n",
        "    \"cedint_f1_hourly_clean.csv.gz\",\n",
        "    low_memory=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"timestamp_local\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"timestamp_local\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calendar variables\n",
        "df[\"hour\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.hour\n",
        "df[\"weekday\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.day_name()\n",
        "df[\"month\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.month\n",
        "df[\"year\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.year\n",
        "df[\"is_weekend\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.dayofweek >= 5\n",
        "\n",
        "# Year-month for real monthly totals\n",
        "df[\"year_month\"] = df[\"timestamp_local\"].dt.to_period(\"M\").astype(str)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Keep only usable series\n",
        "df_use = df[df[\"usable_for_model\"] == 1].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "weekday_order = [\n",
        "    \"Monday\", \"Tuesday\", \"Wednesday\",\n",
        "    \"Thursday\", \"Friday\", \"Saturday\", \"Sunday\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Main loads prioritised by the project\n",
        "load_types = [\"HVAC\", \"Lighting\", \"Plugs & Sockets\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# 2. AVERAGE POWER BY HOUR OF DAY\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "for load in load_types:\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = df_use[df_use[\"load_type\"] == load]\n",
        "\n",
        "    hourly = (\n",
        "        data.groupby([\"hour\", \"zone\"])[\"power_w\"]\n",
        "        .mean()\n",
        "        .unstack()\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    hourly.plot(figsize=(9,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Hour of day\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Average power (W)\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"{load} - Average power by hour and zone\")\n",
        "    plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# 3. AVERAGE POWER BY WEEKDAY\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "for load in load_types:\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = df_use[df_use[\"load_type\"] == load]\n",
        "\n",
        "    weekday_profile = (\n",
        "        data.groupby([\"weekday\", \"zone\"])[\"power_w\"]\n",
        "        .mean()\n",
        "        .unstack()\n",
        "        .reindex(weekday_order)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    weekday_profile.plot(kind=\"bar\", figsize=(10,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Weekday\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Average power (W)\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"{load} - Average power by weekday and zone\")\n",
        "    plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "    plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# 4. MONTHLY ENERGY TOTALS\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "for load in load_types:\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = df_use[df_use[\"load_type\"] == load]\n",
        "\n",
        "    monthly = (\n",
        "        data.groupby([\"year_month\", \"zone\"])[\"energy_wh_model\"]\n",
        "        .sum()\n",
        "        .unstack()\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    monthly.plot(figsize=(12,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Month\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Total energy (Wh)\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"{load} - Monthly total energy by zone\")\n",
        "    plt.xticks(rotation=60)\n",
        "    plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# 5. WORKING DAYS VS WEEKENDS\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "for load in load_types:\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = df_use[df_use[\"load_type\"] == load]\n",
        "\n",
        "    workweek = (\n",
        "        data.groupby([\"is_weekend\", \"zone\"])[\"power_w\"]\n",
        "        .mean()\n",
        "        .unstack()\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    workweek.plot(kind=\"bar\", figsize=(8,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Day type\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Average power (W)\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"{load} - Working days vs weekends by zone\")\n",
        "    plt.xticks(\n",
        "        [0,1],\n",
        "        [\"Working days\", \"Weekend\"],\n",
        "        rotation=0\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# 6. AUGUST VS OTHER MONTHS\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "df_use[\"is_august\"] = df_use[\"month\"] == 8\n",
        "\n",
        "for load in load_types:\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = df_use[df_use[\"load_type\"] == load]\n",
        "\n",
        "    august = (\n",
        "        data.groupby([\"is_august\", \"zone\"])[\"power_w\"]\n",
        "        .mean()\n",
        "        .unstack()\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    august.plot(kind=\"bar\", figsize=(8,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Period\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Average power (W)\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"{load} - August vs other months by zone\")\n",
        "    plt.xticks(\n",
        "        [0,1],\n",
        "        [\"Other months\", \"August\"],\n",
        "        rotation=0\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# 7. MATCHED PERIOD COMPARISON:\n",
        "#    AUG-OCT 2020-2023 VS AUG-OCT 2025\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "for load in load_types:\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = df_use[\n",
        "        (df_use[\"load_type\"] == load) &\n",
        "        (df_use[\"month\"].isin([8,9,10]))\n",
        "    ].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    data[\"period\"] = data[\"year\"].apply(\n",
        "        lambda x: \"2020-2023\" if x <= 2023 else \"2025\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    period_profile = (\n",
        "        data.groupby([\"period\", \"zone\"])[\"power_w\"]\n",
        "        .mean()\n",
        "        .unstack()\n",
        "        .reindex([\"2020-2023\", \"2025\"])\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    period_profile.plot(kind=\"bar\", figsize=(8,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Period\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Average power (W)\")\n",
        "    plt.title(\n",
        "        f\"{load} - Aug-Oct 2020-2023 vs Aug-Oct 2025 by zone\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    plt.xticks(rotation=0)\n",
        "    plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# 8. COVID-2020 CHECK\n",
        "#    SAME AUG-OCT WINDOW\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "def covid_period(year):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if year == 2020:\n",
        "        return \"2020\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif year in [2021, 2022]:\n",
        "        return \"2021-2022\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif year == 2025:\n",
        "        return \"2025\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return None\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "for load in load_types:\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = df_use[\n",
        "        (df_use[\"load_type\"] == load) &\n",
        "        (df_use[\"month\"].isin([8,9,10]))\n",
        "    ].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    data[\"period_covid\"] = data[\"year\"].apply(covid_period)\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = data.dropna(subset=[\"period_covid\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "    covid_profile = (\n",
        "        data.groupby([\"period_covid\", \"zone\"])[\"power_w\"]\n",
        "        .mean()\n",
        "        .unstack()\n",
        "        .reindex([\"2020\", \"2021-2022\", \"2025\"])\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    covid_profile.plot(kind=\"bar\", figsize=(8,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Period\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Average power (W)\")\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"{load} - COVID period comparison by zone\")\n",
        "    plt.xticks(rotation=0)\n",
        "    plt.legend(title=\"Zone\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()"
      ],
